releases.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind!
The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings
9 R.I.P. sequel
releases.summary:
The previous work, "9 RIP," weaves the story of a bizarre love and the supernatural encounters in the afterlife. In this "9 RIP sequel," you can enjoy the continuation of the story.

The work begins with the two endings from the previous work. The main content, "Heaven Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: Heaven," is a sequel that depicts a new horror.

The sub-content, "God Edition," which takes place after "Final Act: God," is a fan disc that leads to a sweet and happy ending.

Please look forward to the various strange worlds and the fate of the strange characters and the love that is woven once again.

releases.name: PACKING SHIFT
releases.summary: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

releases.name: Mr. Tanaka
releases.summary: A fixed-camera, real-time stealth horror game set in an empty apartment block at night. You can't look around, and you can't fight back. Track him by his footsteps, hide when he gets close, and run when he sees you. Find the axe and break out. Survive three nights. Every night is different.

releases.name: Junkyard Astronauts
releases.summary: Scavenge a junkyard, weld the scrap into a rocket of questionable structural integrity, and light it. Highest flight wins the shift — the Moon is 384,400 km up and your fuel tank is a rain barrel. 1-4 robots, one shared launch pad, no appeals.

releases.name: Capsule Arcade
releases.summary: A cozy first-person tidying game in a neon capsule-toy arcade. Crack open capsules, sort 216 cute figures into their display cases and bring six dark floors of Hoshizora Capsule Hall back to life, one glowing machine at a time.

releases.name: Demon Egg
releases.summary: The roguelike tower defense card game where one card wins the run: Hatch. Grow your economy to afford it sooner, power up your main spell or overwhelm enemies with a swarm. Shape your build through a randomized skill tree and defend your egg until you can pay the price to hatch.

releases.name: Piecework: The Jigsaw Museum
releases.summary: Thirty masterpieces, nearly twenty-eight thousand pieces, and every single one of them is on the floor. Put the museum back together in a cozy first-person jigsaw game: as the Curator, with a few tricks up your sleeve, or on the Night Watch, with nothing but a good eye.

releases.name: Magic Awakening: Hero Saga
releases.summary: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

releases.name: Farm Story Life
releases.summary: Grow crops, care for adorable animals, customize your farm, and build your dream countryside home in this relaxing casual single-player farming adventure.

releases.name: Lord of the Grind
releases.summary: Lord of The Grind is a single-player 2D Action RPG focused on dungeon grinding, resource gathering, loot, crafting and long-term character progression.

releases.name: Dungeon Cleared!
releases.summary: Pick four heroes and enter the dungeon. Hopefully four come back. The rules are simple. The dungeon maybe not. Position your party, manage spells, avoid traps and survive ten procedural levels of old-school turn-based tactics—one short adventure and one questionable decision at a time.
